risk_note: RV2 by path (db migration, catalog, test/spec). Migration 0124 adds the nullable text column app.pool_items.shop_name (no backfill, no default; the table-level grants of 0107 cover it). Adding to a pool writes the latest union detail's shop_name (NULL when absent); a pool refresh writes it only from a valid latest item (union failure, not_passed or a price anomaly leave the row alone); the pool reader hands a non-empty shop_name to card-assembler. Never filled from a title or nick. db/schema.sql and db.gen.ts regenerated by db:snapshot (one line each). No amounts change.

reviews.note: Codex via tools/agent/codex-run.sh. Round 1 pass, no findings. Static, nothing executed.
